THBSUMMARY OF FACTORS AFFECTING GOLD PRICES 
IN OCTOBER 2025
I. Monetary Policy of the U.S. Federal Reserve 
(FED):
The Federal Reserve continues to maintain a prudent monetary 
stance following its indication that interest rates will be reduced in a 
gradual manner. Investors anticipate that the FED may implement 
interest rate cuts of 0.25 percent in both October and December 2025 
in response to emerging signs of an economic slowdown. These 
expectations have reinforced confidence in the prospect of future 
monetary easing, which serves as a supportive factor for gold prices 
given its nature as a non -interest -bearing asset. Concurrently, the 
anticipated depreciation of the U.S. dollar resulting from projected 
rate reductions is expected to further underpin gold prices over the 
medium term.
II. Trade War between the United States and 
China:
Trade tensions between the United States and China have re -
escalated following the U.S. government's announcement, under the 
administration of President Donald Trump, of a new round of tariffs 
on Chinese imports. This renewed conflict has placed additional 
pressure on the global economic outlook and heightened uncertainty 
across financial markets, resulting in a depreciation of the U.S. dollar 
relative to other major currencies. Consequently, gold prices have 
been bolstered by increased demand for safe -haven assets, as a 
significant number of investors have shifted toward gold holdings to 
mitigate risks associated with a trade dispute that appears likely to 
be prolonged.
III. U.S. Government Shutdown:
In addition to trade -related issues, market participants have 
continued to monitor the U.S. government shutdown, which resulted 
from delays in the approval of a temporary budget bill by Congress, 
leading to the partial suspension of certain federal operations. This 
situation has heightened economic uncertainty and prompted 
investors to reduce exposure to riskier assets, such as equities, 
while increasing allocations to gold. Consequently, gold prices have 
received sustained support throughout October 2025 .
